sabbah13-cowork-tasks-coach.description: Reviews the owner's current board and gives a short coaching read - what to start with, what's blocked, what should be deleted because it's not actually theirs to do. Use when the owner asks "what should I do?", "help me prioritize", "review my board", or seems stuck.

sabbah13-cowork-tasks-health.description: Reports Cowork Tasks health - which connectors are wired up, board task counts, and any errors. Use when the user asks about Cowork Tasks status or whether it is working.

sabbah13-cowork-tasks-new-task.description: Captures a personal action item the owner wants to do, in action-verb form. Use when the owner says they need to do, remember, follow up on, or commit to something.

sabbah13-cowork-tasks-open-board.description: Opens the Cowork Tasks kanban board as an artifact in the Claude desktop app, reusing the same artifact every time. Use when the user asks to open, show, or check their board, kanban, tasks, or inbox.

sabbah13-cowork-tasks-setup.description: Helps the user check or enable the connectors that Cowork Tasks reads from. Use when the user asks how to connect a source, on first run, or when triage reports a missing connector.

sabbah13-cowork-tasks-triage-now.description: Scans the owner's connected sources (email, calendar, chat, issue trackers, meetings, CRM, incidents, files, design tools) and converts ONLY the owner's own action items into Cowork Tasks - skipping watch/FYI items, work owned by others, and dashboards. Use when the owner wants to refresh their personal action list.
